items.briefing:
Australian finance teams are being warned to stay alert to payment scams, with fraudsters increasingly targeting businesses through invoice and transfer fraud. Separately, property tech firm PEXA reports that homebuyer confidence in scam protection is falling — a reminder that real estate transactions remain a high-risk area for cybercriminals intercepting communications and redirecting funds.

If your role involves approving payments or property settlements, always verify account details by calling the recipient directly using a number you already have on file — never rely solely on details provided in an email.

featured.title: PEXA flags drop in scam confidence among homebuyers
featured.summary: Fewer Australians can spot property settlement scams, with confidence in identifying them falling to 41% as AI voice fraud worries grow.
